entries.headline: Marvel’s Wolverine Launches on PS5 Alongside Official Merchandise
entries.summary: Marvel’s Wolverine, developed by Insomniac Games in collaboration with Marvel Games, has launched on PS5. PlayStation also unveiled official apparel, accessories, and home goods, with selected items available this week through PlayStation Direct and retailers in the United States.
entries.verification: The first-party PlayStation Blog post supports the launch and merchandise plans; retail availability is limited to the U.S. channels explicitly named on the page.
entries.timeNote: PlayStation Blog's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Minecraft Dungeons II Joins Xbox Game Pass on Day One, September 29
entries.summary: Minecraft Dungeons II will join Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass on day one, September 29, across cloud, console, handheld, and PC. The sequel takes players into the Sift with new lands, threats, and gear customization.
entries.verification: The first-party Xbox Wire lineup supports the date, service tiers, platforms, and the game-specific overview.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: CONTROL Resonant Details PS5 Performance and DualSense Support
entries.summary: Remedy says CONTROL Resonant was built around 60fps responsiveness and supports DualSense adaptive triggers. Travel between Manhattan's Zones and Dylan's mental space, the Gap, is nearly instantaneous, while the main story is estimated at 25 to 35 hours.
entries.verification: The first-party developer article supports the PS5 features, traversal details, and main-story estimate used here.
entries.timeNote: PlayStation Blog's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Helldivers 2 Ironclad Democracy Warbond Arrives September 22
entries.summary: Helldivers 2 will receive the Ironclad Democracy Warbond on September 22, adding new weapons, armor, and other equipment.
entries.verification: The first-party PlayStation Blog post supports the Warbond name, content categories, and date; the excerpt does not list every individual item.
entries.timeNote: PlayStation Blog's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Launches March 4, 2027
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo's Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember will launch March 4, 2027, for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC. A limited-time Alpha Demo became available on September 16.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and Famitsu independently support the release date and Alpha Demo; the platform list comes from AUTOMATON's opened report.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: ノロイあやし: Looping Horror Adventure Noroi Ayashi Announced for 2027
entries.summary: Game Source Entertainment has announced Noroi Ayashi, an exploration horror adventure in which school newspaper club member Seira investigates seven school mysteries and the cursed doll Aya on a campus at night, using different avoidance and sealing methods to break a deadly loop.
entries.verification: The packet opened only AUTOMATON, not a publisher or store page, so the item remains a media relay of the announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Wizardry VI 禁断の魔筆: Wizardry VI Kindan no Mahitsu Steam Port Announced
entries.summary: Drecom has announced a Steam port of Wizardry VI Kindan no Mahitsu for 2027. The version traces back to the 1995 Super Famicom port of the 1990 game Wizardry VI: Bane of the Cosmic Forge.
entries.verification: The packet opened only AUTOMATON, not a Drecom or Steam page, so the item remains a media relay of the announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: ひぐらしの哭く頃に 雀 REMASTER: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jan REMASTER Announced
entries.summary: City Connection has announced Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jan REMASTER for PS5, Nintendo Switch, and PC in 2027. The HD remaster of the 2009 two-player mahjong game includes the PSP-added Pai Kuzushi chapter and a post-game gallery.
entries.verification: The packet opened only AUTOMATON, not a publisher, press release, or store page, so the item remains a media relay of the announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Masahiro Sakurai Says the Japan Game Awards’ Game Designers Award Will End
entries.summary: IGN reports that Masahiro Sakurai was unable to find a successor after several years, bringing the Game Designers Award he founded in 2010 to an end. The text-based puzzle game Word Game became its final winner.
entries.verification: The reason for ending the award and the final result remain attributed to IGN because the packet did not open the ceremony video or CESA source.
entries.timeNote: IGN's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave developers discuss its world, gameplay, and music
entries.summary: Part 3 of Nintendo’s Ask the Developer Vol. 23 continues its interview with the Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave team, discussing the world’s atmosphere, which differs from Fire Emblem: Three Houses, as well as gameplay and music design. The game is scheduled to launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on September 17.
entries.verification: Nintendo’s official developer interview was opened. The source gives a publication date but no exact time, so timing is treated as date-only.
entries.timeNote: The Nintendo page lacks an exact publication time. The packet places the event within this edition’s window; the canonical note uses the window’s upper bound as a stand-in and marks timing as date-only.

entries.headline: Aniimo launches globally with more than 200 Aniimo to collect
entries.summary: Pawprint Studio has confirmed Aniimo’s global launch. More than 200 Aniimo can be discovered, befriended, and collected at launch. Based on testing feedback, the team has also adjusted Legendary Aniimo encounters, held-item mechanics, Legendary Stardust production, and progression pacing.
entries.verification: The first-party developer article on Xbox Wire was opened; claims are strictly limited to its text.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire’s publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: Sony announces PlayStation Pulse and Pulse Edge Wireless Headsets
entries.summary: Sony has announced the new PlayStation Pulse and Pulse Edge wireless headsets. They feature larger planar magnetic drivers, PlayStation Link low-latency lossless audio, simultaneous Bluetooth connectivity, and AI-enhanced microphone noise rejection, with white and Midnight Black color options.
entries.verification: The first-party PlayStation Blog product announcement was opened; claims are strictly limited to its text.
entries.timeNote: PlayStation Blog’s publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: Plants vs. Zombies: The Board Game plans an October 14 Kickstarter launch
entries.summary: Mantic Games is adapting Plants vs. Zombies into a cooperative board game for one to four players. Players work together against increasingly challenging stages and zombies; the project plans to launch on Kickstarter on October 14.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report describes Mantic Games’ board-game adaptation and crowdfunding plans. Only the player count and crowdfunding date explicitly given in the report are used.
entries.timeNote: The IGN packet timestamp is September 15, 2026 at 20:04 UTC, or September 16 at 04:04 Beijing time, within the fixed window. No more precise event time is inferred.

entries.headline: Valve engineer says memory shortages have had little impact on Steam Deck successor plans
entries.summary: AUTOMATON relays IGN’s interview with Valve engineer Pierre-Loup Griffais: memory shortages currently have little impact on planning for a Steam Deck successor. The team is still waiting for technology that can deliver a clear generational performance improvement and has not given a launch timeframe.
entries.verification: The selected AUTOMATON source attributes the interview to IGN and names Pierre-Loup Griffais. The relay is not recast as a new Valve announcement, and no release date is added.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON packet timestamp is September 15, 2026 at 04:24 UTC, or 12:24 Beijing time, within the fixed window. The time when the interview took place was not disclosed.

entries.headline: NHN PlayArt interview introduces OVER RUSH, with an open test set for September 17–24
entries.summary: AUTOMATON interviews development producer 寺田康太 about the high-speed card-battle design of NHN PlayArt’s OVER RUSH. The report says the game is planned for iOS, Android, and PC via Steam, with an open test scheduled for September 17–24.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON page is an interview with development producer 寺田康太. The subject is corrected to OVER RUSH, as explicitly named in the text, rather than retaining the misparsed #コンパス title. Test dates and platforms are limited to the article.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON packet timestamp is September 15, 2026 at 08:17 UTC, or 16:17 Beijing time, within the fixed window. The time when the interview took place was not disclosed.

entries.headline: Escape from Tarkov update 1.1.5.1 to add weekly League promotion contests
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Battlestate Games began server maintenance for version 1.1.5.1 on September 15. The update will add League experience-point ranking contests in which 50 players of the same rank compete each week, with the top 25 by experience advancing.
entries.verification: A single opened AUTOMATON report supports the maintenance date, update version, and League rules. The item remains a media report and does not claim that an official announcement was opened separately.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON packet timestamp is September 15, 2026 at 08:21 UTC, or 16:21 Beijing time, within the fixed window. The exact maintenance time and League launch time are not stated as confirmed facts.
